name: Viral Pharyngitis
source: NICE NG84 — Sore throat (acute): antimicrobial prescribing — https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng84
note: Absence of severe throat pain, absence of tonsillar swelling, and presence of cough/rhinorrhea distinguish this from both Streptococcal Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis in this knowledge base.
